scripts.text: I should go. He's just being stubborn.
scripts.translation: 我该走了。他就是在闹脾气。

scripts.text: Frankly, I don't understand why he would want to do this, but I don't want to stop him.
scripts.translation: 说实话，我不明白他为什么非要这么做，但我不想阻止他。

scripts.text: Demon, some strange kid is just hanging out around us. Do you know him?
scripts.translation: 恶魔，有个奇怪的小孩一直在我们附近晃悠。你认识他吗？

scripts.text: Who? Where? I don't see him. Send him to me.
scripts.translation: 谁？在哪儿？我没看见。让他过来找我。

scripts.text: You're carrying so much stuff, I'm worried you might break your shoulder. Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation: 你带这么多东西，我都担心你会压伤肩膀。先清出些背包空间吧。

scripts.text: You're still wet behind the ears. This place is too dangerous for you. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation: 你还嫩着呢，这里太危险了。过些时候再来，好吗？

scripts.text: You have no idea how dangerous this place is, do you? Get out of here while you can.
scripts.translation: 你根本不知道这里有多危险吧？趁还能走，赶紧离开。

scripts.text: You came back quickly. Ah, I miss being young.
scripts.translation: 你这么快就回来了。唉，真怀念年轻的时候。

scripts.text: But look, I still have left some of the materials you brought me yesterday. I can't use all these.
scripts.translation: 不过你看，昨天带来的材料我还剩下一些，根本用不完。

scripts.text: Why don't you go home and come back next morning?
scripts.translation: 先回家吧，明天早上再来。

scripts.text: Hey, kiddo! It's very nice to see you again. The bomb I made with the materials you brought is in the aging process. Did you know wine and bombs get better the older they are?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小家伙！很高兴又见到你。你带来的材料做成的炸弹正在熟化呢。你知道吗，酒和炸弹一样，放得越久越够味？

scripts.text: Now, could you bring some more materials today? We're a long way from having all the bombs we need.
scripts.translation: 今天能再带些材料来吗？我们离凑齐需要的炸弹还差得远呢。

scripts.text: As usual, get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation: 照旧，带来10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉，再猎杀15只瓦斯魔。明白了吗？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We'll be counting on you, kiddo!
scripts.translation: 小家伙，这事就拜托你啦！

scripts.text: Alright, this should do. You know what I need, right? Are you sure you could sneak in? Maybe I should go.
scripts.translation: 好，这些应该够了。你知道我需要什么吧？你确定能悄悄溜进去吗？要不还是我去吧。

scripts.text: I'll go while everyone's in bed.
scripts.translation: 等大家睡着了，我就进去。

scripts.text: But the noise could wake them up. There'll be guards, too.
scripts.translation: 可动静可能会把他们吵醒，而且里面还有守卫。

scripts.text: I'll be alright. We all look alike? They won't know I'm not one of them.
scripts.translation: 没事，我们长得都差不多，他们认不出我不是自己人。

scripts.text: Mister, what are you doing here?
Why are you playing with fire in the middle of nowhere? You're suspicious.
scripts.translation: 你们为什么在荒郊野外玩火？看起来很可疑啊。

scripts.text: Hey, a kid is asking you a question. He looks so curious that I'm worried he might die if you don't tell him.
scripts.translation: 喂，这孩子在问你呢。他好奇得不得了，你不告诉他，我担心他会急坏的。

scripts.text: Little kids like him are full of curiosity. You'd better tell him before he starts crying.
scripts.translation: 这孩子好奇心得很。趁他还没哭，你最好告诉他吧。

scripts.text: No. Why should I? He asked you. Plus, kids usually give me heartburn.
scripts.translation: 我才不说，凭什么？是他问你的。而且小孩总让我头疼。

scripts.text: I had my favorite bean dish for breakfast today. I can't lose it. I want it to become part of me.
scripts.translation: 我今天早餐吃了最喜欢的豆子料理，可舍不得浪费。我想把它消化吸收，变成身体的一部分。

scripts.text: Some of it has to come out of you eventually. Poor beans. They'd be angry to be eaten by jerks like you.
scripts.translation: 反正最后总得排出来。可怜的豆子，竟被你这种混蛋吃掉，肯定气坏了。

scripts.text: Oh, right! Why don't we ask this kid?
scripts.translation: 哦，对了！不如问问这孩子？

scripts.text: What? But we can't trust him? We've just met him!
scripts.translation: 什么？我们能信任他吗？我们才刚认识！

scripts.text: Yes, we can. People are supposed to trust each other. You didn't know that, did you? Now that he's here, he's one of us now. And I told you, everyone's born good.
scripts.translation: 当然能。人与人本来就该互相信任嘛，你不知道吗？他既然来了，就是我们的人了。我早告诉过你，人人生来都是善良的。

scripts.text: Plus, doesn't he look like he's used to rough things? He has a runner's body and keen eyes that miss nothing. I like kids like him.
scripts.translation: 而且这孩子看起来吃得了苦。他身手敏捷，眼神也锐利，什么都逃不过他的眼睛。我喜欢这样的孩子。

scripts.text: Hey, kiddo. How'd you like to join us in business?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小家伙，想不想加入我们一起做生意？

scripts.text: You look dangerous. I don't want to do anything dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你们看起来很危险，我可不想干危险的事。

scripts.text: You don't? Alright, then I won't force you. Take care now. This place is dangerous. You'd better get out of here.
scripts.translation: 不想啊？好吧，我不勉强你。保重，这里很危险，最好赶紧离开。

scripts.text: Are you sure we can let him go? He's seen us.
scripts.translation: 真要放他走？他都看见我们了。

scripts.text: Why are you so paranoid? It's okay, kiddo. Just go. But come back if you change your mind!
scripts.translation: 你也太疑神疑鬼了。没事的，小家伙，走吧。改变主意的话再回来！

scripts.text: Unless you're going to explain it yourself, just shut up and let me do it!
scripts.translation: 你要是不打算亲自解释，就闭嘴让我来说！

scripts.text: That's more like it. Anyway, we're going to rob the ^0000cdmine^000000.
scripts.translation: 这才像话。总之，我们要去抢矿场。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You didn't have to tell him that. You could've just asked him to get the things for us.
scripts.translation: 你没必要告诉他这些，直接让他帮我们拿东西不就行了。

scripts.text: We can't make him do things for us without explanation. He has the right to know what he's getting himself into.
scripts.translation: 总不能什么都不解释就让他替我们做事吧。他有权知道自己要掺和什么。

scripts.text: You want to take advantage of a stranger.
scripts.translation: 你就是想利用这个陌生人。

scripts.text: No. I'm asking you to be in on our great plan. Anyway, you know the mine east of here? It used to belong to Gold Moon?
scripts.translation: 才不是，我是在邀请你加入我们的绝妙计划。对了，你知道这附近东边的矿场吗？以前是金月的。

scripts.text: So, anyway, the Buffalo Bandits realized how lucrative the mine was and took up residence in there.
scripts.translation: 后来野牛强盗发现矿场很赚钱，就占下来住进去了。

scripts.text: Hey, did you just get released? So are we! In fact, we've met there. I've met most of my best friends while we were in the system.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你刚放出来吗？我们也是！说起来，我们在里面见过。我最好的几个朋友都是在牢里认识的。

scripts.text: I miss the smell of the stone floor. And the coolness.
scripts.translation: 我还挺怀念石地板的气味，还有那股凉意。

scripts.text: I liked the food, too. I hated beans until I went to jail. All the beans I've eaten aren't half as good as those I ate in there.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢那里的伙食。进监狱前我讨厌豆子，可我吃过的豆子没有一种比得上牢里的。

scripts.text: Why did you go to jail?
Are you going to tell him that too?
Why not? I loved that story. You want to hear it, don't you?
scripts.translation: 为什么不呢？我可喜欢讲那个故事了。你也想听吧？

scripts.text: I'm really good with my hands, and I like fireworks. What do you think would be the best job for someone like me?
scripts.translation: 我手很巧，又喜欢烟火。你觉得我这种人最适合做什么工作？

scripts.text: Close, but I make something stronger: ^0000cdbombs^000000. And mines are just about the best thing that could happen to people like me.
scripts.translation: 差不多，不过我做的是更厉害的东西：炸弹。对我们这种人来说，矿场简直是再好不过的地方。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: People working at the mines always need bombs. I came here, hoping I could make some money while doing what I love.
scripts.translation: 矿工总是需要炸弹。我来这里就是想一边做喜欢的事，一边赚点钱。

scripts.text: And it's because of you! One night, some guys came to me and said they heard I was a bomb specialist. They demanded I donate bombs to them.
scripts.translation: 都怪你！有天晚上，几个人来找我，说听说我是炸弹专家，逼我捐些炸弹给他们。

scripts.text: One look at them, and I knew they were the infamous ^0000cdBuffalo Bandits^000000. It was obvious why they wanted my bombs.
scripts.translation: 我一看就知道他们是臭名昭著的野牛强盗。他们要我的炸弹干什么，显而易见。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And you still gave them to them.
What else could I do? A bunch of scary-looking buffaloes who were at least a head taller than me, mind you? Demanded I give them my bombs.
scripts.translation: 那我还能怎么办？那帮野牛一个个凶神恶煞，至少比我高出一头，还命令我交出炸弹。

scripts.text: No, I couldn't have stood my ground. You weren't there. Anyway, those buffaloes used my bombs to blow up the ore train and take over the mine. Guess what happened to me afterward.
scripts.translation: 我哪敢跟他们对着干？你当时又不在。总之，那些野牛用我的炸弹炸毁了矿石列车，占领了矿场。猜猜后来我怎么样了？

scripts.text: The sheriff traced the bombs back to me and dragged me with him.
scripts.translation: 警长查到炸弹是我做的，就把我抓走了。

scripts.text: And you got thrown in jail.
And guess who I met there: this guy. He was caught in the explosion that blew up the train, and those heartless buffaloes left him to die.
scripts.translation: 猜猜我在那儿遇见了谁？就是这家伙。他被炸毁列车时波及，那些冷血的野牛却把他扔在那里等死。

scripts.text: And the sheriffs were no better than them. They just left him bleeding all over the cell. What could I do? I couldn't let anyone die if I could help it, so I treated him.
scripts.translation: 警长也好不到哪去。他们就任由他在牢房里血流不止。我能怎么办？只要还有办法，我就不能见死不救，于是替他治了伤。

scripts.text: He's been following me around since then.
scripts.translation: 从那以后他就一直跟着我。

scripts.text: Yes. Or why did you save me when I came to the mine to get even with the buffaloes? They kicked you out because of me.
scripts.translation: 没错。要不然我来矿场找野牛报仇时，你为什么救我？他们还因为我把你赶走了。

scripts.text: Did you get your revenge after you were released?
I don't want to talk about it. I made so many stupid mistakes, which wasn't like me at all. That's why we were hiding out in this dark, dank place.
scripts.translation: 我不想提那件事。我犯了太多蠢错误，根本不像平时的我。所以我们才躲在这个阴暗潮湿的地方。

scripts.text: So, what can I do to help?
Are you sure you want to help? Because I don't like forcing people, or sending them in harm's way. If you really want to help, then you can get some bomb materials for me.
scripts.translation: 你确定要帮忙？我不喜欢强迫别人，也不想让人冒险。你真想帮的话，就替我找些炸弹材料吧。

scripts.text: Why, so you could rob the mine?
scripts.translation: 找材料是为了抢矿场吗？

scripts.text: No. Technically speaking, we'd ^0000cdreclaim the mine^000000. Have you seen what's going in the village? Since those buffaloes took over the mine, most of the people lost their jobs.
scripts.translation: 不，严格来说，我们是要夺回矿场。你也看到村里的情况了吧？野牛占了矿场后，大多数人都失业了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Without a job, they can't make money, and without money, they can't feed themselves. This is terrible.
scripts.translation: 没工作就赚不到钱，没钱就没饭吃。实在太糟了。

scripts.text: I want to throw a ^0000cdfirework party inside the mine^000000 and ^0000cdscare away the bandits^000000.
scripts.translation: 我想在矿场里办一场烟火派对，把强盗吓跑。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But, Mr. Midnight, they used to be your...
scripts.translation: 可是，午夜先生，他们以前是你的...

scripts.text: Don't worry about him. He cut ties with them a long time ago. He has no love for those buffaloes who abandoned him. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 别管他。他早就和他们断绝来往了，对抛弃自己的野牛也没什么感情。对吧？

scripts.text: Well, I'll be dipped in buttermilk.
No, I'm not worried about them, but I am worried about us. If this goes wrong?
scripts.translation: 我不是担心他们，我是担心我们。万一计划失败了呢？

scripts.text: The sheriffs will throw us in jail if the bandits don't kill us. But it's okay. I like the beans there.
scripts.translation: 要是没被强盗杀掉，我们就会被警长抓进监狱。不过没关系，我喜欢牢里的豆子。

scripts.text: If this goes well, we can get out of this cesspit and I can work at the mine again. So can you.
scripts.translation: 计划顺利的话，我们就能离开这个鬼地方，我也能回矿场工作。你也一样。

scripts.text: Anyway, kiddo, are you sure you can help us? There are monsters inside the mine that looks like cotton balls. Hunt them, and they'll leave behind deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder.
scripts.translation: 小家伙，你确定能帮我们吗？矿场里有些像棉花团一样的魔物。猎杀它们就能拿到毒药粉和爆炸粉。

scripts.text: I need 10 Deadly Poison Powders and.. let me see.. 1 Explosive Powder.
scripts.translation: 我需要10份毒药粉，还有...让我想想...1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Deadly poisonous powder? Are you going to kill them? You said you just want to scare them away.
scripts.translation: 毒药粉？你要杀了他们吗？你不是说只想把他们吓跑吗？

scripts.text: It's deadly only to humans and Dorams. To those Tauruses, it only causes allergic reactions, like itching and sneezing.
scripts.translation: 这东西只对人类和多兰族致命。那些牛头人只会过敏，发痒、打喷嚏而已。

scripts.text: No. You're going to get caught and ruin our plan before it even begins.
scripts.translation: 不行，你会被抓，计划还没开始就得泡汤。

scripts.text: Ah kiddo, speaking of which, could you cull some Gasters? That'll help us set up bombs later.
scripts.translation: 啊，对了小家伙，你能顺便清理些瓦斯魔吗？之后布置炸弹时用得上。

scripts.text: The buffaloes would get out of the mine when the fireworks starts, but those clumps of gas could trigger chain reaction and blow up the entire mine. Hunt 15 of them for now. Can you do it?
scripts.translation: 烟火一放，野牛就会逃出矿场。不过那些气团可能引发连锁爆炸，把整个矿场炸飞。先猎杀15只吧，能办到吗？

scripts.text: I asked yes or no. Oh well, I'll take that as a yes.
scripts.translation: 我问你行不行呢。算了，我就当你答应了。

scripts.text: Now, here's the lowdown: get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation: 我说说具体要做什么：带来10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉，另外猎杀15只瓦斯魔。明白了吗？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We'll be counting on you, kiddo! I'll repay you generously when you come back. I was able to nab a few things while in jail at the sheriff's office. Now, off you go!
scripts.translation: 小家伙，这事就拜托你啦！回来后我会好好答谢你。我在警长办公室坐牢时顺了几样东西。好了，出发吧！

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, kiddo, you forgot to hunt all the Gasters. We can't have Gasters around while we work.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，小家伙，你还没把瓦斯魔都清理掉。干活时可不能让它们留在附近。

scripts.text: Hunt just 15 Gasters. There's no rush. You can take your time. Just come back before the end of the day today. I want to see you again.
scripts.translation: 猎杀15只瓦斯魔就行，不用着急。今天结束前回来就好，我还想再见你一面。

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 10 Deadly Poison Powders. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，你还没带来10份毒药粉。这是做炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text: Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation: 小家伙，这点事难不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找10份毒药粉和1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 1 Explosive Powder. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，你还没带来1份爆炸粉。这是做炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text: Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation: 小家伙，这点事难不倒你吧？去瓦斯魔身上找1份爆炸粉。

scripts.text: Let's see... Ooh, kiddo, you got everything done! You hunted Gasters and brought what I asked.
scripts.translation: 我看看...哇，小家伙，你全都办妥了！瓦斯魔也猎杀了，东西也带齐了。

scripts.text: This is enough to keep me awake all night.
scripts.translation: 这些够我兴奋得一整晚睡不着了。

scripts.text: Hey kiddo, do you mind helping me again tomorrow? I need more than one bomb to throw a firework party.
scripts.translation: 嘿，小家伙，明天还能再帮我一次吗？办烟火派对可不止要一颗炸弹。

scripts.text: Go rest today and come back tomorrow in the morning. See ya!
scripts.translation: 今天先去休息，明天早上再来。回头见！

scripts.text: Aww, just one look at them,
and all I want to do is sneeze...
What are you looking at? Were you eavesdropping on me?
scripts.translation: 看什么看？你在偷听我说话吗？赶

scripts.text: Get your butt outta here! Git!
Oh, you want to help me again.
Thanks, but I only have to patrol once a day. Why don't you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.?
scripts.translation: 次啊。谢了，不过我一天只巡逻一次。明天凌晨4点后再来吧。

scripts.text: Ah, stranger! You came to help again, right?
scripts.translation: 啊，陌生人！你又来帮忙了，对吧？

scripts.text: Why not? Are you too busy today?
scripts.translation: 怎么不帮了？今天有事吗？

scripts.text: Don't worry about your payment; I've got it covered. Just go get the job done.
scripts.translation: 报酬不用担心，我会负责。你只管把事情办好。

scripts.text: Maybe I should take a giant fan with me.
scripts.translation: 么办？要不带把大风扇过去？不

scripts.text: No. No, then everyone will find out.
scripts.translation: 行，那样大家都会发现的。谁

scripts.text: Mm? I'm pretty sure I haven't seen you around.
You're not one of the vigilantes.

scripts.translation: 直来坏我们好事的陌生人！

scripts.text: Yes, those clumps of gas. They make me sneeze something fierce,
scripts.translation: 没错，就是那些气团。害我不停打喷嚏，弄

scripts.text: and turn into a weeping, drooling, sniffling mess. *Shudder*
scripts.translation: 得眼泪鼻涕直流，狼狈不堪。*打了个寒颤*

scripts.text: Now, I've been assigned to go on patrol inside the mine, and I can't do it because of them.
scripts.translation: 我被派去矿场巡逻，可那些东西害我根本没法去。我们

scripts.text: But we Taurases take pride in our physical superiority. How can I tell the others that I can't do my job because I'm allergic to some gas?
scripts.translation: 牛头人一向以体格强壮为傲，我怎么能告诉别人，我因为对某种气体过敏才没法工作？

scripts.text: Hunt ^FF000020 Gasters^000000 before I get in there.
scripts.translation: 在我进去前，先猎杀20只瓦斯魔 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Come on, I said I'd repay you.
Bah! Alright, then I won't force you.
But you'd better not tell anyone about this. Got it?
scripts.translation: 。不过这事可别告诉别人，听见了吗？

scripts.text: Really? Thanks! I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation: 真的吗？谢谢！就拜托你了！

scripts.text: Oh, and make sure no one knows about this.
scripts.translation: 对了，千万别让别人知道。

scripts.text: That'll be bad for both of us.
How many Gasters did you hunt?
scripts.translation: 你猎杀了多少只瓦斯魔？

scripts.text: I'm ready to go on patrol. Let me know when you're done.
scripts.translation: 我已经准备好去巡逻了。你完成后告诉我。

scripts.text: I'll be counting on you, stranger.
scripts.translation: 陌生人，一切就拜托你了。

scripts.text: Did you hunt all of them? By the way, why are you carrying so much stuff?
scripts.translation: 都猎杀完了吗？对了，你怎么带了这么多东西？先去

scripts.text: Did you catch them all? I'd better finish my rounds before more of them spring up.
scripts.translation: 都解决了吗？趁它们还没再冒出来，我得赶紧巡逻。谢了

scripts.text: If you're not busy, come by tomorrow and help me again. I'll repay you.
scripts.translation: 有空的话明天再来帮我一次吧，我会付你报酬。

scripts.text: This works for both of us, don't you agree?
scripts.translation: 这对我们双方都有好处，对吧？

scripts.text: Hello. Are you new to this place? You should be ^FF0000at least Level 100^000000 to stay here comfortably?
scripts.translation: 你好，是新来这里的吗？想在这里待得舒坦，至少得达到100级吧？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Wait, what is my husband feeding that dog? Honey! That was our dinner!
scripts.translation: 等等，我丈夫在喂那只狗什么？亲爱的！那是我们的晚饭！

scripts.text: S-sweetheart, you shouldn't be outside when it's so windy. Let's go in.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的，风这么大，你不该待在外面。我们进屋吧。

scripts.text: Grr, I can't believe you! You're getting only half your dinner tonight!
scripts.translation: 哼，真不敢相信你！今晚你只能吃一半的晚饭！

scripts.text: He's an angel when he's in sleep, but... sigh... I already have a headache, just thinking about what he might do when he wakes up ^FF0000after 4:00 a.m.^000000
scripts.translation: 他睡着时简直像个天使，可是...唉...一想到他凌晨4点醒来后又会干出什么事，我就头疼。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for coming back. We've checked all the holes Spotty dug inside the village, but we couldn't find what we were looking for. He must have taken it to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，谢谢你回来。我们检查了斑点在村里挖的所有坑，都没找到要找的东西。它肯定把东西叼到荒地去了。

scripts.text: As I told you before, we've got something for you this time: ^0000CD1 Rock Ridge Coin^000000. Say, could you help us?
scripts.translation: 就像之前说的，这次我们会给你1枚洛克理奇硬币。对了，你能帮我们吗？ ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: We have no one else to turn to. Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 我们实在找不到别人帮忙了。改变主意的话，请再来找我们。

scripts.text: Today Spotty took a {0}. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation: 斑点今天叼走了一个{0}。你能帮忙找找吗？虽然这东西不难买，但我总不能每次它叼走东西都去买新的。

scripts.text: Go outside the village and talk to my husband. He'll tell you where it might be.
scripts.translation: 去村外找我丈夫谈谈，他会告诉你东西可能在哪儿。

scripts.text: Spotty would be a perfect dog if he doesn't take things out of the house. Sigh...
scripts.translation: 要是斑点不把家里的东西叼出去，它就真是只完美的狗了。唉...

scripts.text: After all the time we spent searching the village, we've found it inside his house.
scripts.translation: 指了！在村里找了半天，最后竟然在他家里找到了。

scripts.text: By the way, what's that shining thing in your hand?
scripts.translation: 对了，你手里那个闪闪发亮的东西是什么？

scripts.text: Oh, you want to ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first before showing it to me. Sure!
scripts.translation: 哦，你想先清出些背包空间再给我看啊。好吧！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: This is a Rock Ridge Coin. You can use it like money inside the village. I wasn't comfortable letting you help us for free. I'm glad you can at least have this.
scripts.translation: 这是一枚洛克理奇硬币，在村子里可以当钱用。我不想让你白帮忙，能收下这个就好。

scripts.text: That Rock Ridge Coin is yours. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 这枚洛克理奇硬币给你了，谢谢你帮忙。

scripts.text: And, mm... Do you mind helping us again tomorrow? Spotty keeps taking things from the house to the wasteland, and we need them back.
scripts.translation: 还有...你明天能再帮我们一次吗？斑点总把家里的东西叼到荒地去，我们得把东西找回来。

scripts.text: Spotty tired itself out and fell asleep. Could you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.? We'll have something to give you next time.
scripts.translation: 斑点累得睡着了。明天凌晨4点以后再来好吗？下次我们会给你准备谢礼。

scripts.text: Did you find what we asked? I can't see it because you're carrying too much stuff with you. Could you ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first?
scripts.translation: 找到我们要的东西了吗？你带的东西太多，我看不清。能先清出些背包空间吗？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You've found it! Thank you so much. We've been trying to correct Spotty's behavior, and it's difficult.
scripts.translation: 找到了！太感谢你了。我们一直在努力改掉斑点的坏习惯，可真不容易。

scripts.text: Here's the Rock Ridge Coin we promised. Thank you for searching the wasteland for us.
scripts.translation: 这是答应给你的洛克理奇硬币。谢谢你替我们去荒地找东西。

scripts.text: Could you come back again? If you're not busy, you're welcome anytime after 4:00 a.m each day.
scripts.translation: 还愿意再来帮忙吗？有空的话，每天凌晨4点以后都欢迎你。

scripts.text: How many times do I have to tell you to keep your dog away from our things? Do you really want me to send it away on a ship?
scripts.translation: 我得说多少次才行，别让你的狗碰我们的东西？你真想让我把它装船送走吗？

scripts.text: Why? What did he do this time?
scripts.translation: 为什么？它这次又闯什么祸了？

scripts.text: I can't live like this anymore! Guess what Spotty stole this time? My ring!
scripts.translation: 我再也受不了了！猜猜斑点这次偷了什么？我的戒指！

scripts.text: HONEY! Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation: 亲爱的！你到底有没有在听我说话？！

scripts.text: My mom gave me that ring before I left for this foreign land. I was keeping it for a rainy day, and that mongrel stole it from me!
scripts.translation: 那是我离开故乡来这片异乡之前，妈妈送我的戒指。我一直留着以防万一，结果那只狗竟然把它偷走了！

scripts.text: You mean the gold ring you love? Uh-oh, Spotty is in big trouble.
scripts.translation: 你是说你最喜欢的那枚金戒指？糟了，斑点这次要倒大霉了。

scripts.text: I tried to be understanding when it took our shoes and laundry and buried them in the ground, but no, not my ring!
scripts.translation: 它把我们的鞋子和衣服叼走埋起来时，我都尽量体谅它了，可这次不行！它竟然偷我的戒指！

scripts.text: Sweetheart, please calm down. Is it possible you left it where he could reach it?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的，先冷静一下。有没有可能是你把戒指放在它够得到的地方了？

scripts.text: Are you kidding me? I never take it off except when I do the dishes or laundry,
scripts.translation: 你开玩笑吗？我只有洗碗或洗衣服时才会摘下来，而

scripts.text: and even then I keep it in my pocket. I dropped it just this once, and that mongrel got ahold of it!
scripts.translation: 且也会放进口袋。就那一次不小心掉了，马上就被那只狗叼走了！

scripts.text: It's been two months since you quit your job, and instead of helping around the house, you've been spoiling that dog. You're responsible for its misbehavior!
scripts.translation: 你辞职都两个月了，不帮忙做家务，倒是整天宠那只狗。它会变成这样都怪你！

scripts.text: I saw it run to the wasteland. Go find my ring. You'd better not come back home without it!
scripts.translation: 我看见它跑去荒地了。去把我的戒指找回来。找不到就别回家！

scripts.text: What? I'm a miner, not a fighter? I can't go out there! You know I couldn't stay out there long enough to find my hat when it flew away in that direction.
scripts.translation: 什么？我是矿工，又不是打手，怎么敢去那里！你还记得我的帽子被风吹到那边时，我连找都不敢多待一会儿。

scripts.text: I don't know, and I don't care!
- That's none of my business. I'm just going to pass. -
scripts.translation: - 这不关我的事，我还是不插手吧。 -

scripts.text: Ah, you're the adventurer who just arrived in these parts. Hah hah, don't be so surprised. I know because
scripts.translation: 啊，你就是刚来这一带的冒险者。哈哈，别这么惊讶，我知道是因为...

scripts.text: you sit by the dock all day, playing with the dog. Of course, I know everyone who comes and goes.
scripts.translation: 你整天坐在码头边陪狗玩。来来往往的人，我当然都认识。

scripts.text: *Clenches his teeth* Sweetheart, let's not start it right now.
scripts.translation: *咬紧牙关* 亲爱的，先别吵了。对了

scripts.text: Anyway, what can we do for you?
Say you want to help them find the ring.
scripts.translation: 告诉他们你愿意帮忙找戒指。

scripts.text: Huh? You want to help us. Thank you, but no, thanks. We can't pay you.
scripts.translation: 什么？你想帮我们？谢谢，不过不用了，我们付不起报酬。

scripts.text: And I know for a fact that no one offers help for free anymore.
scripts.translation: 而且我敢说，现在没人会白白帮忙。

scripts.text: Wait, honey. You should think again. You and I are too afraid of the Buffalo Bandits to go out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 等等，亲爱的，再想想。我们都怕野牛强盗，根本不敢去荒地。

scripts.text: We have no one else to turn to, and I can't think of a better way than this. Let's take a chance on this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我们也找不到别人帮忙，我想不出更好的办法了。就相信这位冒险者一次吧。

scripts.text: Mm, Adventurer, let me take back what I just said. Please help us.
scripts.translation: 嗯，冒险者，刚才的话我收回。请帮帮我们。

scripts.text: Spotty digs holes and buries things in them every day. If you find holes in the wasteland, please look inside them.
scripts.translation: 斑点每天都会挖洞埋东西。你要是在荒地发现洞，帮忙看看里面吧。

scripts.text: My husband and I will look around the village, just in case. If you find something, please come back here.
scripts.translation: 我和丈夫也会在村里找找，以防万一。找到东西的话，请回来告诉我们。

scripts.text: I picked up Spotty in the wasteland. Maybe that's why he loves spending time there so much. But he never ventures so far out that he can't make it home before it's mealtime. At least, not yet.
scripts.translation: 我是在荒地捡到斑点的，也许这就是它那么爱往那儿跑的原因。不过它从不会跑得太远，总会赶在吃饭前回家。至少目前是这样。

scripts.text: Go out to the wasteland, and you'll see the marks that I've left on your map. You don't have to search any places beyond them.
scripts.translation: 去荒地后，你会看到我在地图上标出的记号。搜到那些地方就够了，不用再往外找。

scripts.text: Honey, you should at least follow the adventurer to the gates, so you could tell him where to look.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的，你至少把冒险者送到大门口，告诉他该去哪里找吧。

scripts.text: My wife said Spotty went out the back door and ran straight past the barbed-wire fence.
scripts.translation: 我妻子说斑点从后门溜出去，直接跑过了铁丝网围栏。

scripts.text: But he couldn't have gone too far because he came back to me pretty quickly. Why don't you walk along the fence and look for holes with white hair floating around them?
scripts.translation: 不过它应该没跑太远，因为很快就回来了。沿着围栏找找看，留意附近有白毛的洞。

scripts.text: Did you find something? Then let's go back!
scripts.translation: 找到东西了吗？那我们回去吧！

scripts.text: My wife sent me here to give you directions, but I have no idea where he might have been.
scripts.translation: 我妻子让我来指路，可我也不知道它可能跑去哪儿了。

scripts.text: Oh, right! Spotty has been shedding a lot lately. Maybe you should look for holes with white hair floating around them.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了！斑点最近掉了很多毛。你可以找找周围有白毛的洞。

scripts.text: And he doesn't seem to venture out too far. It's probably because he's still young. I've marked three possible locations in the middle of your map. You don't have to look further than those locations.
scripts.translation: 它好像不会跑得太远，大概还小吧。我在地图中间标了三个可能的位置，不用去那些地方以外搜。

scripts.text: Ah, Adventurer. Shhh! Please keep your voice down: the Buffalo Bandits might hear us.
scripts.translation: 啊，冒险者。嘘！小声点，野牛强盗可能会听到我们。

scripts.text: I've been coming here whenever I can, to catch Spotty before he takes more things out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation: 我一有空就来这里，想趁斑点再把东西叼去荒地前抓住它。

scripts.text: My wife says she'd throw him out, but she doesn't mean it. She never raises her hand no matter how angry she is with him either, and she always remembers to feed him vitamins and get him vaccinated.
scripts.translation: 我妻子嘴上说要把它赶出去，其实不会那么做。不管多生气，她也从没打过它，还总记得给它吃维生素、带它打疫苗。

scripts.text: She didn't say anything when I quit my job because I was too scared of the Buffalo Bandits. She's a good woman.
scripts.translation: 我因为害怕野牛强盗而辞职时，她一句怨言都没有。她真是个好女人。

scripts.text: - There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has wet soil inside it. -

scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面空空如也。 -

scripts.text: - I don't have to search farther than this. -
scripts.translation: - 不用再往更远的地方找了。 -

scripts.text: - There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面散落着几缕白毛。 -

scripts.text: It has something shining inside it,
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面有东西闪闪发亮，

scripts.text: But it's not a gold ring.
I should take it with me for now. -

scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面有些东西。 -

scripts.text: - This must be what Mr. McPhy is looking for. I should bring it to her. -
scripts.translation: - 这肯定就是麦克菲夫人要找的东西。我该拿给她。 -

scripts.text: It only has a stone sticking out of the ground inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面只有一块石头从土里露出来。 -

scripts.text: It has a small animal bone inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面有根小动物的骨头。 -

scripts.text: It has a tumbleweed rolling around inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面有团风滚草在打转。 -

scripts.text: A small insect is scuttling around inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面有只小虫子在爬。 -

scripts.text: It only has weeds growing inside it. -
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞，里面只长着杂草。 -
- 地上有个洞，里面只有灰尘。 -

scripts.text: - He looks more like a coyote than a dog. -
scripts.translation: - 他看起来更像郊狼，而不是狗。 -

scripts.text: - He's asleep, covered in dirt as if he rolled around in it. I shouldn't wake him up. -
scripts.translation: - 他睡着了，浑身是土，像是在泥地里打过滚。我还是别叫醒他。 -

scripts.text: - He looks more like a coyote than a dog. -
scripts.translation: - 他看起来更像郊狼，而不是狗。 -

scripts.text: - He's shedding a lot of hair. He must be leaving white hair all over the place wherever he goes. -
scripts.translation: - 他掉毛掉得很厉害，走到哪儿都会留下白毛。 -

scripts.text: Spotty, do you want a treat? Hmm?
My wife and I decided to check the village separately, but I'm not sure if we'd be done before you're back.
scripts.translation: 我和妻子分头在村里找东西了，但不知道你回来前能不能找完。

scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for checking that dangerous area for my wife's gold ring.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，谢谢你替我妻子去危险的地方找金戒指。

scripts.text: I believe the universe has brought you to us as an act of Providence. Do you mind if I ask you one more favor?
scripts.translation: 我相信是命运把你带到我们身边的。能再请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Listen to what he has to say.
I can really repay you this time. Please let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 这次我真的能给你报酬。改变主意的话告诉我一声。

scripts.text: We keep a rifle in the house for self-defense purposes, and the other day I noticed Spotty trembled like a leaf when he saw it.
scripts.translation: 家里放着一把自卫用的步枪。前几天我发现斑点一看到它就吓得浑身发抖。

scripts.text: I'm glad I was too scared to have it loaded. Spotty wouldn't have come back home if he smelled gunpowder.
scripts.translation: 幸好我当时怕得没敢装子弹。斑点要是闻到火药味，恐怕就不肯回家了。

scripts.text: I think someone fired a gun near Spotty, but it didn't happen inside the village. We would've heard if it did.
scripts.translation: 我想有人在斑点附近开过枪，不过不是在村里。不然我们早就听到了。

scripts.text: I think it happened in the wasteland and that one of the Buffalo Bandits fired at our dog. Could you avenge Spotty on my behalf?
scripts.translation: 我猜是在荒地里，有个野牛强盗朝我们的狗开了枪。你能替斑点报仇吗？

scripts.text: Since you brought back my wife's gold ring, I've been taking odd jobs to supplement our income. We can afford to repay you now.
scripts.translation: 你帮我妻子找回金戒指后，我一直在打零工贴补家用。现在我们有能力付你报酬了。

scripts.text: You're not afraid of the bandits, are you?
scripts.translation: 你不怕那些强盗吧？要是你

scripts.text: Okay, I understand if you can't help us.
scripts.translation: 帮不了我们，我也能理解。

scripts.text: Since there's no way of knowing exactly who scared Spotty, I'd like you to hunt 3 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane.
scripts.translation: 没法确定究竟是谁吓到了斑点，所以想请你每种都猎杀3只：黄鬃毛、黑鬃毛和白鬃毛的强盗。

scripts.text: Spotty, are you alright? Don't be scared. Daddy's with you.
scripts.translation: 斑点，你没事吧？别怕，爸爸在这儿。

scripts.text: Those evil bandits, how could they shoot their guns near puppies?
scripts.translation: 那些可恶的强盗，怎么能在小狗附近开枪呢？

scripts.text: Ah, Adventurer. Did you hunt ^FF00003 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane^000000?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你猎杀了黄鬃毛、黑鬃毛和白鬃毛的强盗各3只吗？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Ah, you must have forgotten about your payment. Please go ^FF0000make some room in your bag^000000 for it.
scripts.translation: 啊，你可能忘了领报酬。请先腾出些背包空间。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Did you take care of all the darned Buffalo Bandits?
scripts.translation: 那些该死的野牛强盗都解决了吗？

scripts.text: But there are so many of them that this wouldn't even leave a dent on them. I want to take it further.
scripts.translation: 他们人太多了，这点损失根本不算什么。我想再加把劲。

scripts.text: We should do this just once a day. They would know something is amiss if we get rid of too many of them at once. Please come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.
scripts.translation: 一天做一次就好。一下子解决太多，他们会起疑心。明天凌晨4点以后再来吧。

scripts.text: Oh, right?here's your payment I promised. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，这是答应给你的报酬。谢谢。

scripts.text: Honey! Did Spotty take my watch?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的！斑点是不是把我的手表叼走了？

scripts.text: Let me see what time it is... It's not past ^FF00004:00 a.m.^000000 yet. Could you come back later?
scripts.translation: 我看看时间...还没到凌晨4点呢，能晚点再来吗？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, I've been waiting for you! You came to avenge Spotty on the Buffalo Bandits, right?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我一直在等你！你是来替斑点向野牛强盗报仇的吧？

scripts.text: As usual, please hunt ^FF00003 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane^000000.
scripts.translation: 照旧，请猎杀黄鬃毛、黑鬃毛和白鬃毛的强盗各3只 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Oh, poor Spotty. You're itching from losing so much hair. Do you want your daddy to brush you?
scripts.translation: 可怜的斑点，掉了这么多毛，身上一定痒吧？要爸爸帮你梳梳吗？

scripts.text: Coyotes have been attacking our villages often lately, so we've asked some adventurers to cull them.
scripts.translation: 最近郊狼频频袭击村庄，所以我们请了一些冒险者来减少它们的数量。

scripts.text: It worries me that our children thinks hunting is just for fun.
scripts.translation: 我担心孩子们会以为打猎只是好玩。

scripts.text: We start to teach our young how to hunt early on,
scripts.translation: 我们从小就开始教他们狩猎，

scripts.text: and I understand they want to become as strong as those adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我明白他们想变得和冒险者一样强。但我

scripts.text: But we Cacti don't hunt for pleasure. Teaching that to our children is challenging while adventurers are around them constantly.
scripts.translation: 们仙人掌人打猎不是为了取乐。冒险者总在孩子身边，要教会他们这一点可不容易。

scripts.text: I love traveling. I had fun traveling in Pa-sta, and I'm determined to spend the rest of my life traveling in Rune-Midgarts and other cities and villages that I can reach from the kingdom.
scripts.translation: 我喜欢旅行。在帕斯塔旅行时玩得很开心。我决定余生都在卢恩-米德加兹，以及王国内能去到的城镇之间游历。

scripts.text: I like being in new places and talking to the residents. I can learn many things from the way they live.
scripts.translation: 我喜欢去新的地方，和当地人聊天，也能从他们的生活方式中学到很多。

scripts.text: I love these new musical instruments!
scripts.translation: 我太喜欢这些新乐器了！

scripts.text: This instrument itself is a work of art.
scripts.translation: 这件乐器本身就是艺术品

scripts.text: Check out the exquisite finish around the drum skin, and the well-balanced, full-bodied sound from the barrel.
scripts.translation: 。看看鼓皮边缘精巧的做工，再听听鼓身传出的浑厚和谐的音色。

scripts.text: Ah, I want to beat this drum! I'd love to hear its sound!
scripts.translation: 啊，我好想敲敲这个鼓，听听它的声音！

scripts.text: *Gasp* Taneska, please don't touch it! You were warned once already!
scripts.translation: *倒吸一口凉气* 塔涅斯卡，别碰它！我已经警告过你一次了！

scripts.text: The strangers lost the battle with the sea and relinquished their homes. I thought they'd leave, but they're as resilient as weeds; they built another village on top of their old homes.
scripts.translation: 那些外来者败给了大海，只好放弃家园。我以为他们会离开，没想到竟像野草一样顽强，又在旧居上建起了新村子。

scripts.text: Mother Nature allows weeds to grow. She's allowing them to stay here.
scripts.translation: 大自然允许野草生长，也允许他们留在这里。

scripts.text: I know, Litis. I'm just being a stubborn old mule.
scripts.translation: 我知道，利蒂斯。我只是头倔驴，脾

scripts.text: But still I can't help but think that everything's happening too fast.
scripts.translation: 气太固执。可我还是觉得，一切发生得太快了。

scripts.text: My mom is better at hunting coyotes than any adventurer. I can hunt them, too!
scripts.translation: 我妈妈打猎比任何冒险者都厉害！我也会猎杀郊狼！

scripts.text: Karintas, has your mom ever hunted them for pleasure?
scripts.translation: 卡林塔斯，你妈妈有为了好玩吗？

scripts.text: Mm, no. She hunts them only when we need their fur and meat.
scripts.translation: 嗯，没有。只有需要它们的皮毛和肉时，妈妈才会去猎杀。

scripts.text: Hurting nature should never be a game. These adventurers only hunt enough coyotes to keep us safe from them.
scripts.translation: 伤害自然可不是游戏。这些冒险者猎杀郊狼，只是为了保障大家的安全。

scripts.text: If you get old enough to understand that, your mother will teach you how to hunt.
scripts.translation: 等你长大，明白其中道理后，妈妈就会教你怎么打猎。

scripts.text: I'm the best coyote-hunting adventurer! I'm going to hunt a hundred coyotes!
scripts.translation: 我是最厉害的猎狼冒险者！我要猎杀一百只郊狼！

scripts.text: I-I'm Captain Adventurer! I'm going to hunt a hundred-hundred-hundred-hundred coyotes!
scripts.translation: 我、我是冒险队长！我要猎杀一百、一百、一百、一百只郊狼！

scripts.text: You rascals, I told you not to play adventurers?they're not playing!
scripts.translation: 你们这些小鬼，我不是说过别玩冒险者游戏吗？他们可不是在玩！

scripts.text: *Whine* But we want to hunt coyotes like them. Yap! Yap, yap! Hoi!
scripts.translation: *呜咽* 可我们也想像他们那样猎杀郊狼。汪！汪汪！嘿！

scripts.text: Maybe the grownups in our village should go out and hunt coyotes, too.
scripts.translation: 也许村里的大人们也该出去猎杀郊狼。

scripts.text: You knuckleheads, we don't want to hunt them.
scripts.translation: 你们这些傻孩子，我们不想猎杀它们

scripts.text: We want to live with them peacefully in this Kiwawa Desert.
scripts.translation: 。我们想在契瓦瓦沙漠里和它们和平共处。

scripts.text: It's just not safe for us to have too many coyotes around. That's why we asked the adventurers for help.
scripts.translation: 只是郊狼太多就不安全，所以我们才请冒险者帮忙。但这

scripts.text: But that doesn't mean we want to get rid of all of them.
scripts.translation: 不代表我们想把它们赶尽杀绝。

scripts.text: I understand what Mr. Glaring Eagle means and why he's so worried.
scripts.translation: 我明白怒目之鹰先生的想法，也理解他为何如此担忧。

scripts.text: But the river today is not the same river it was yesterday. Things keep changing, and it's natural.
scripts.translation: 今天的河流已不是昨天的河流。世事总在变化，这本就是自然之理。

scripts.text: *Gasp* I'm back in the Cactus village. Aww, I'm lost? again.
scripts.translation: *倒吸一口气* 我又回到仙人掌村了。哎呀，又迷路了...

scripts.text: The Kiwawa Desert is vast and full of nothing but dirt and rocks. It's easy to get lost in it.
scripts.translation: 契瓦瓦沙漠辽阔无边，满眼只有泥土和石头，很容易迷路。

scripts.text: Gosh, I'm really not up to yet another excursion... I hope I could get a glass of cool water before I leave.
scripts.translation: 天哪，我可不想再来一趟这样的旅程了...希望离开前能喝杯凉水。

scripts.text: Follow this road east to get to the inn, the sheriff's office, shops, and the plaza.
scripts.translation: 沿路向东走，可到旅馆、警长办公室、商店和广场。

scripts.text: This road also goes outside the village, to the Kiwawa Desert.
scripts.translation: 这条路也通往村外的契瓦瓦沙漠。

scripts.text: The Kafra services are available inside the Rock Ridge Plaza.
scripts.translation: 洛克理奇广场内设有卡普拉服务点。

scripts.text: The sheriff's office and shop buildings are west of this plaza. The inn and the port are farther west.
scripts.translation: 广场西边是警长办公室和商店，再往西就是旅馆和港口。

scripts.text: Do you want to go back to Alberta?
No problem. I don't mind staying here for a little longer.
scripts.translation: 没问题，我不介意在这里多待一阵子。

scripts.text: In fact, my company would like that too.
scripts.translation: 其实公司也希望我留下。

scripts.text: Mm, mm! Agave juice is the best thing I've tasted in Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation: 嗯，嗯！龙舌兰汁是我在洛克理奇喝过最好喝的饮料。

scripts.text: I've heard it's a traditional drink of the Cacti. When I drink it, it feels as if it washes away all the dust clogging up my throat.
scripts.translation: 听说这是仙人掌人的传统饮料。喝下去就像把堵在喉咙里的灰尘全冲走了。

scripts.text: Err, wait. It's not real agave juice. It says agave-flavored juice.
scripts.translation: 呃，等等，这不是真正的龙舌兰汁。包装上写着“龙舌兰味果汁”。

scripts.text: Ack, does it even have agave in it?
scripts.translation: 咦，里面到底有没有龙舌兰？

scripts.text: I hope you'll find your opportunity in this land of dreams.
scripts.translation: ！愿你在这片梦想之地找到属于自己的机会。
欢迎来到洛克理奇，冒险者

scripts.text: I hope you'll enjoy exploring this wonderful place.
scripts.translation: ！祝你在探索这片美丽土地时玩得开心。

scripts.text: I'm waiting for my sister. She's supposed to be on the next ship.
scripts.translation: 我在等我妹妹，她应该会搭下一班船来。我

scripts.text: I came here first and invited her over here.
scripts.translation: 先到了这里，再叫她过来的。

scripts.text: She was worried sick when I decided to leave for this continent a year ago.
scripts.translation: 一年前我决定来这片大陆时，她担心得不得了。看到我在这

scripts.text: She'll be happy to see me doing well.
scripts.translation: 里过得不错，她一定会很开心。

scripts.text: The land of opportunity, that's Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation: 洛克理奇，就是充满机遇的地方。

scripts.text: My gramps is the best Cactus I know!
scripts.translation: 我爷爷是我认识的最棒的仙

scripts.text: Sometimes he says things that I can't understand, but it's okay.
scripts.translation: 人掌人！有时他说的话我听不懂，不过没关系。

scripts.text: I hope I can understand him better when I grow as tall as he.
scripts.translation: 等我长得和他一样高，就希望能更听懂他

scripts.text: I want to grow up quickly, so I could ask him to tell me the things he told me again.
scripts.translation: 的话。我想快点长大，再让他给我讲讲以前那些事。

scripts.text: Some Cacti don't like the pioneers, but, Leaf, remember they're also children of Mother Nature.
scripts.translation: 有些仙人掌人不喜欢拓荒者，不过叶子，要记得他们也是大自然的孩子。

scripts.text: Children? Are they as cute as Leaf?
scripts.translation: 他们也是孩子吗？有叶子这么可爱吗？

scripts.text: Of course. Everyone even this old man is a child in the eyes of Mother Nature.
scripts.translation: 当然。就连我这样的老爷爷，在大自然眼里也是孩子。

scripts.text: Hah hah hah! That doesn't make sense. You're tall and have a mustache. Babies don't have mustaches.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！这不可能。你又高又有胡子，宝宝才没有胡子呢。

scripts.text: I'm saying you should be nice to them like you are to your friends.
scripts.translation: 我是说，你也要像对待朋友一样友善地对待他们。

scripts.text: Yes. Leaf is a good Cactus and he loves his gramps.
scripts.translation: 懂了。叶子是个乖仙人掌人，也很爱爷爷。

scripts.text: Have you just arrived? So have I, two days ago. The wind sounds different here. I love it!
scripts.translation: 你刚来这里吗？我也是，两天前才到。这里的风声听起来很不一样，我喜欢！

scripts.text: All the buildings smell like fresh paint, and I hear the sound of hammering everywhere I go. This village is alive!
scripts.translation: 所有建筑都有股新油漆的味道，走到哪儿都能听见敲打声。这村子真有活力！

scripts.text: Just standing here makes me so happy that I can't stop laughing. Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation: 光是站在这里就让我开心得直想笑。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: My dad works at the train station.
scripts.translation: 我爸爸在火车站工作。是在

scripts.text: It's east? mm, wait. West is the left hand side, and...
scripts.translation: 东边吗？嗯，等等，西边是左手边，那...

scripts.text: Just look at your map and go straight up. You'll be at the train station.
scripts.translation: 看地图，一直往前走就到火车站了。我爸爸

scripts.text: My father is so strong, he can carry many boxes at once!
scripts.translation: 力气可大了，一次能搬好多箱子！

scripts.text: *Hiccups* I can drink beer all day long!
scripts.translation: *打嗝* 我可以喝一整天啤酒！

scripts.text: Let's make money and - hee hee! - eat something delicious!
scripts.translation: 咱们赚点钱，再——嘿嘿！——吃顿好吃的！

scripts.text: I want more chicken, nya! And chicken is really easy on my stomach.
scripts.translation: 我还要吃鸡肉，喵！而且鸡肉吃了胃很舒服。

scripts.text: Cheers for our great village! Cheers!
scripts.translation: 为我们伟大的村子干杯！干杯！

scripts.text: Rock Ridge is a seaside village. In the beginning?well, even now it's battling with the sea.
scripts.translation: 洛克理奇是个海边村庄。一开始...嗯，直到现在我们都还在和大海搏斗。

scripts.text: Did you know there's one more level underneath this village? That was the original Rock Ridge, and it became uninhabitable because of seawater erosion and groundwater inundation.
scripts.translation: 你知道村子下面还有一层吗？那才是最初的洛克理奇。海水侵蚀、地下水泛滥后，那里就不适合居住了。

scripts.text: Mayor Costell's solution was to bury the first level and build a new village on top of it. And now what used to be the first floor is the basement. The second floor is actually the first.
scripts.translation: 科斯特洛市长决定把原来的一层填起来，再在上面建新村子。如今旧一层成了地下室，而现在的二层其实才是一层。

scripts.text: We still have to pump out water on a daily basis to prevent flooding, but that's just a minor setback?we took one step back to move two steps forward. Rock Ridge will continue to grow.
scripts.translation: 我们每天还得抽水防止水淹，不过只是小小的挫折。退一步是为了进两步，洛克理奇还会继续发展。

scripts.text: I'm tired of being surrounded by so much water! It's the reason we constantly have to repair the ground and buildings standing on it.
scripts.translation: 我受够了周围到处都是水！地面和建在上面的房屋才会需要不停修缮。

scripts.text: Did you know we had to bury what used to be the ground level of the village? That was a difficult decision to make, and it still didn't solve all our problems.
scripts.translation: 你知道村子原来的地面层不得不填埋吗？这个决定很艰难，也没能解决所有问题。

scripts.text: Most of the buildings were made of wood and prone to rotting. It took a lot of money and effort to fill them thoroughly, so our new ground level wouldn't sink in.
scripts.translation: 大多数建筑都是木头做的，很容易腐烂。要把它们彻底填埋，得花很多钱和精力，这样新地面才不会塌陷。

scripts.text: And the filling work still hasn't been finished. Sigh, I don't know if that was even a good decision anymore.
scripts.translation: 填埋工程至今还没完成。唉，我都不知道当初那个决定到底对不对。

scripts.text: We are the great pioneers of Rock Ridge! Hey, ho!
scripts.translation: 我们是洛克理奇伟大的拓荒者！嘿，嚯！

scripts.text: We dig mines, build houses! No seawater or sandstorms can stop us!
scripts.translation: 我们挖矿、盖房子！海水和沙暴都别想拦住我们！

scripts.text: Nya! Nya-nya! Nya hah hah! Nya-nya!
It's five million Zeny. How much money is that?
scripts.translation: 五百万 Zeny？那得是多少钱啊？

scripts.text: Ah, that price is for adventurers only.
scripts.translation: 啊，这个价是卖给冒险者的。像

scripts.text: Pretty little ladies like you can have it at two hundred Zeny.
scripts.translation: 您这样漂亮可爱的小姑娘，两百 Zeny 就卖给您。

scripts.text: Get souvenirs for your family, friends, teachers, and significant other!
scripts.translation: ！给家人、朋友、老师和恋人都带一份吧！

scripts.text: Ah, adventurer. Would you like to buy some souvenirs?
scripts.translation: 啊，冒险者，想买点纪念品吗？

scripts.text: I'll give you a special discount. This feather accessory here is just two million Zeny. This handkerchief here is - oh, wow! - just five million!
scripts.translation: 给你特别优惠！这件羽毛饰品只要两百万 Zeny。这条手帕嘛——哇！——只要五百万！

scripts.text: I assume you came all the way here from the mainland for a reason.
scripts.translation: 你大老远从大陆来这里，肯定有自己的目的。等事

scripts.text: When you're done with it and not sure what else to do, well...
scripts.translation: 情办完后，要是不知道接下来做什么的话...

scripts.text: I recommend you follow the central road to the eastern gate of the village and move a little bit farther south.
scripts.translation: 沿中央大道走到村庄东门，再往南走一小段就行。打开地

scripts.text: It's in the 3 o'clock direction when you open the map.
scripts.translation: 图看，大约是三点钟方向。

scripts.text: There, you can meet people who offer jobs and meals.
scripts.translation: 在那里能找到提供工作和餐食的人

scripts.text: And, of course, they're surrounded by others who want the jobs and meals.
scripts.translation: 。当然，周围也挤满了想找工作、领餐食的人。

scripts.text: I'm not going back home until I become a millionaire!
scripts.translation: 不成为百万富翁，我绝不回家

scripts.text: I was so excited to come here that I got aboard the ship in full mining gear!
scripts.translation: ！我兴奋得穿着整套采矿装备就上船来了！
那块石头看起来不错！嘿哟！

scripts.text: Come out, gold, silver, diamonds! You can't hide from Delbert!
scripts.translation: 出来吧，黄金、白银、钻石！别想躲过德尔伯特！

scripts.text: That's not a mineral vein, it's a decorative rock! Get that pickax away from it, now!
scripts.translation: ？！那不是矿脉，是装饰用的石头！马上把镐子拿开！

scripts.text: Ah, are you an adventurer? Please, help me stop that madman!
scripts.translation: 啊，你是冒险者吗？求你帮我拦住那个疯子！

scripts.text: He got off a ship from the mainland in that heavy mining gear, and then one look at that rock, he turned into a pickax-swinging maniac.
scripts.translation: 他穿着一身沉重的采矿装备从大陆坐船过来，结果看了那块石头一眼，就变成了挥镐狂魔。

scripts.text: It's not a mineral vein but a decorative rock that we villagers moved together. I told him that, but he doesn't care!
scripts.translation: 那不是矿脉，是我们村民一起搬来的装饰石头。我都告诉他了，他却根本不听！

scripts.text: He's in full mining gear, but he can't tell a normal rock from a mineral vein. How stupid is that?
scripts.translation: 穿着整套采矿装备，居然连普通石头和矿脉都分不清，真够蠢的！

scripts.text: Our village is protected by its own group of vigilantes.
scripts.translation: 我们村有自己的义警队守卫。他们

scripts.text: They keep guard over it under Sheriff Warp's command.
scripts.translation: 听从沃普警长的指挥，保护村子。

scripts.text: Our biggest threat is undoubtedly the Buffalo Bandits, but we also have problems with some wild animals.
scripts.translation: 最大的威胁当然是野牛强盗，不过野生动物也带来不少麻烦。至于村子下

scripts.text: And under the village, there's?*Shudder* let's not go there.
scripts.translation: 面嘛...*打了个寒颤* 还是别提了。

scripts.text: Welcome to the city of freedom, Rock Ridge. Odin is with you wherever you go!
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到自由之城洛克理奇。无论你身在何处，奥丁都与你同在

scripts.text: Come to us if you want to hear the god's words.
scripts.translation: ！想聆听神的教诲，就来找我们吧。

scripts.text: We don't need a chapel. Odin doesn't come to buildings, he comes to our hearts.
scripts.translation: 我们不需要教堂。奥丁不住在建筑里，而是在我们心中。

scripts.text: Let's pray to him and show him our gratitude.
scripts.translation: 让我们向他祈祷，表达感激吧。
洛蕾塔修女，我腿好酸。*抱怨

scripts.text: He may not come to buildings, but I want to go sit in one.
scripts.translation: *就算奥丁不住在建筑里，我也想找个地方坐坐。
啊，就是这里，莫里斯修士！

scripts.text: ...Sigh. When the last ship of the day enters the dock, I'll buy you lemonade, limeade, whatever you want.
scripts.translation: ...唉。等今天最后一艘船进港，我就给你买柠檬水、青柠水，想喝什么都行。

scripts.text: So for now, act like the god's servant that you are.
scripts.translation: 所以现在先好好扮演你的神职人员吧。

scripts.text: Lemonade! I mean, the god is with you!
scripts.translation: 柠檬水！我是说，愿神与你同在！

scripts.text: I agree that our heart is our chapel.
scripts.translation: 我同意心灵就是我们的圣堂

scripts.text: But a god can come to cozy bedrooms and a nice-smelling kitchen. We don't have to stand all day in windy ports.
scripts.translation: 。但神也能来到舒适的卧室和香气四溢的厨房呀。我们没必要整天站在风大的港口。

scripts.text: If someone else hears you, they'd think you weren't fed or allowed to sleep for days
scripts.translation: 别人听见你这么说，还以为你几天没吃没睡

scripts.text: when, in fact, you wake up later than the rest of us, every day.
scripts.translation: 呢。可你每天都比我们起得晚。

scripts.text: Wh-what can I do? The god visits me in my dreams.
scripts.translation: 我、我也没办法呀，神明会在梦里来看我

scripts.text: I'm not trying to wake up late!
As I get older, it's getting more difficult to stand outside all day, spreading his words.
scripts.translation: 年纪越大，整天站在外面传扬神的教诲就越吃力。

scripts.text: But I'm as resolved to complete my mission as I was the first day I arrived here.
scripts.translation: 但我完成使命的决心，和刚来这里时一样坚定。

scripts.text: I'm not going to let my physical exhaustion get in the way.
scripts.translation: 我不会让身体的疲惫挡住脚步。

scripts.text: I'll use every ounce of energy in me to spread his teachings to the people of this new land!
scripts.translation: 我要竭尽全力，把神的教诲传给这片新大陆的人们！

scripts.text: I feel happy just by looking at the train station. It's the symbol of our village, you know.
scripts.translation: 光是看着火车站，我就觉得很开心。它可是我们村子的象征。

scripts.text: The mine was pretty far from the village, so transporting ores was a big problem in the beginning.
scripts.translation: 矿场离村子很远，最初运输矿石是个大难题。

scripts.text: The actual development of Rock Ridge began after the train system was finally introduced.
scripts.translation: 铁路建成后，洛克理奇才真正发展起来。当然

scripts.text: Okay, that also aggravated the problem with the Buffalo Bandits, but there's always a dark side to everything.
scripts.translation: ，这也让野牛强盗的问题更严重了，不过凡事都有两面。

scripts.text: But we the people of Rock Ridge are not here to give in, we're here to conquer!
scripts.translation: 但我们洛克理奇人不会屈服，我们要征服这片土地！

scripts.text: I pride myself in protecting cargo here.
scripts.translation: 我以守护这里的货物为荣。我

scripts.text: My job is to protect it against rain, wind, and of course thieves.
scripts.translation: 的工作是保护它们不受风吹雨打，当然还要提防小偷。

scripts.text: Recently though... Hmpf, my pride has been crushed by those damnable Buffalo Bandits.
scripts.translation: 不过最近...哼，那些该死的野牛强盗把我的自尊心都踩碎了。

scripts.text: The train brings ores from the mine, and brings supplies for the miners from this dock.
scripts.translation: 火车把矿场开采的矿石运来，再从这个码头把矿工所需的补给运走。

scripts.text: That's why this place is always busy. A delay here causes a delay everywhere else in Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation: 所以这里总是很忙。这里一耽搁，整个洛克理奇的进度都会受影响。

scripts.text: Stop whining like wimps. Be proud to be part of the team and work harder!
scripts.translation: 别像个懦夫似的抱怨！为自己是团队一员感到骄傲，好好干活！

scripts.text: Ah, I can't move. I'm aching all over.
scripts.translation: 唉，我动不了了，浑身都疼

scripts.text: It doesn't matter whether or not the train comes often. We're always busy.
scripts.translation: 。火车来得勤不勤，我们反正总有忙不完的活。

scripts.text: Hmpf, you're not working hard enough. Tsk, tsk.
scripts.translation: 哼，你还不够努力。啧啧。多

scripts.text: You should be happy you have a job while many others don't!
scripts.translation: 少人没工作呢，你该庆幸自己还有活干！

scripts.text: *Gasp* H-how long have you been standing there? O-of course, I'm happy to have a job!
scripts.translation: *倒吸一口气* 你、你站在那儿多久了？当、当然，我很庆幸有工作

scripts.text: I-I love working at this loading dock. It's the best job I've ever had!
scripts.translation: ！我、我最喜欢在码头干活了，这是我做过最好的工作！

scripts.text: Now that there are more people in the village, there are fewer jobs available. I'm glad I have a job that pays enough to feed my family.
scripts.translation: 村里人口越来越多，工作机会也少了。我很庆幸有份工作，能养活家人。

scripts.text: Hah, hah! I can do this for my daughter!
scripts.translation: 哈哈！为了女儿，我什么都能做到！

scripts.text: I came here because I heard I could become rich quickly, nya.
scripts.translation: 听说这里能很快发财，我就来了，喵。我

scripts.text: I got on a ship to Rock Ridge as soon as I got off the ship from Pa-sta.
scripts.translation: 刚从帕斯塔下船，就立刻转乘了来洛克理奇的船。

scripts.text: Now, I don't care about money anymore. I just want to rest. Nya...
scripts.translation: 现在我不在乎钱了，只想休息。喵..

scripts.text: I've been moving cargo every day since I came here, and my back is killing me. *Mewl*
scripts.translation: .来这里后我每天都搬货，腰都快断了。*喵呜*

scripts.text: At this rate, I'd spend all the Zeny I've earned on paying hospital bills. *Mewl*
scripts.translation: 再这样下去，赚来的 Zeny 全得拿去付医药费了。*喵呜*

scripts.text: I want to go home. We're never going to make a lot of money here.
scripts.translation: 我想回家了，我们在这儿根本赚不到大钱。

scripts.text: No. We just have to stay strong until this is over. There'll be an opportunity for us afterward.
scripts.translation: 不行，只能撑到这阵子过去。之后总会有机会的。

scripts.text: But this is too much to handle. I don't think I can do this anymore.
scripts.translation: 可这实在太难熬了，我觉得自己撑不下去了。

scripts.text: Come on, let's be patient for a little longer.
Why isn't there any metal here? Some must have dropped when the train was attacked.
scripts.translation: 这里怎么连块金属都没有？火车遇袭时肯定掉了些。

scripts.text: If there was, someone else has to have found it by now.
scripts.translation: 就算掉了，现在也早被别人捡走了吧。

scripts.text: Sigh, then there's nothing here we could sell. Where should we go now?
scripts.translation: 唉，这里没什么能卖的了。接下来去哪儿呢？

scripts.text: Maybe we should go back to the mainland.
What? No! I don't want to be a liar! We told our family we'd be back with loads of money.
scripts.translation: 什么？不行！我不想骗人！我们都跟家里说过会赚一大笔钱再回去。

scripts.text: There aren't many people in this restaurant.
Who would want to eat such terrible food?
scripts.translation: 这么难吃的东西，谁会想来吃啊？

scripts.text: Oh, do you know where the best eatery in this place is?
scripts.translation: 对了，你知道这附近最好吃的地方在哪儿吗？

scripts.text: The sheriff's office. Those in the underground jail are fed three times a day, and the food is so great that some people actually commit a misdemeanor for it.
scripts.translation: 警长办公室啊。地下牢房里的囚犯一天能吃三顿，伙食好到有人还真为了吃饭故意犯点小罪。

scripts.text: Does that make sense to you? I don't believe there's prison food worth committing a crime for.
scripts.translation: 你觉得这可信吗？我可不信有哪家监狱的伙食好到值得犯罪。

scripts.text: Why are they staring at us?
scripts.translation: 他们为什么一直盯着我们？

scripts.text: Ugh, their staring eyes are making me feel too uncomfortable to eat.
scripts.translation: 唉，他们盯得我浑身不自在，饭都吃不下了。

scripts.text: Why do you keep poking at me?
Ah, yes, this is the sheriff's office. Do you have to wait in line, you ask?
scripts.translation: 对，这里是警长办公室。你问要不要排队吗？

scripts.text: Mm, you're an adventurer, right? Then just move past that door and go straight ahead.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你是冒险者吧？从那扇门进去，一直往前走就行。

scripts.text: You're here to help the Sheriff, right? We're here to ask him for help, so I understand you have to see him before the rest of us.
scripts.translation: 你是来帮警长的吧？我们是来找他求助的，所以你先去见他也应该。

scripts.text: Never mind me. I completely understand. Aww, I've been standing on my feet for so long, I can barely move my legs!
scripts.translation: 不用管我，我完全理解。唉，我站太久了，腿都快迈不动了！

scripts.text: The sheriff's office is understaffed. I've been waiting in line all day, and the line is as long as it was when I first arrived. I've been hearing strange noises from my basement, and I really need someone to come and check them.
scripts.translation: 警长办公室人手不够。我排了一整天，队伍还是和刚来时一样长。地下室一直传来奇怪的声音，我真得找人去看看。

scripts.text: Our sheriff doesn't have legal authority, but still his office is the only place that we could turn to for this kind of thing.
scripts.translation: 警长虽然没有执法权，但这种事我们也只能来这里求助。

scripts.text: I hope things in the village will settle soon, starting with this line.
scripts.translation: 希望村里的问题能尽快解决，就先从这条队伍开始吧。

scripts.text: The sheriff has been so busy dealing with the Buffalo Bandits that he doesn't have time for anything else. I've been here waiting for him for hours.
scripts.translation: 警长忙着对付野牛强盗，顾不上别的事。我已经在这里等了好几个小时。

scripts.text: Many people in the village are jobless, and all available jobs are given to adventurers.
scripts.translation: 村里很多人都失业了，能做的工作却全分给了冒险者。

scripts.text: The only thing that thrives because of this influx of adventurers is the inn.
scripts.translation: 冒险者涌入后，唯一兴旺起来的就只有旅馆。

scripts.text: Maybe I should've opened an inn myself.
Welcome to the Lazy Owl's Inn.
Looking for a place to stay? You came to the right place!
scripts.translation: 想找地方住？你来对地方了！要开间房吗？

scripts.text: Would you like a room? It's 5,000 Zeny.
I'm sorry, but it's 5,000 Zeny to get a room.
If you don't have enough money, then I can't let you stay.
scripts.translation: eny。钱不够的话，我就没法让你入住。

scripts.text: Enjoy your stay at the Lazy Owl's.
scripts.translation: 祝你在懒猫旅馆住得愉快。

scripts.text: Boohoo! Where the hell is the sheriff's office? My money! Moneeeyyy!
scripts.translation: 呜呜！警长办公室到底在哪儿？我的钱！我的钱啊！

scripts.text: Everyone said Rock Ridge is the land of opportunity! Why didn't anyone tell me about the scary Buffalo Bandits?
scripts.translation: 大家都说洛克理奇遍地是机会！怎么没人告诉我这里有可怕的野牛强盗？

scripts.text: *Hiccups* They robbed me clean. I don't even have enough money left to have a glass of Kahluna Milk.
scripts.translation: *打嗝* 他们把我的钱全抢走了，我连买杯卡鲁娜牛奶的钱都不剩。

scripts.text: Grandpa said we shouldn't follow strangers, or they'd pluck all our thorns. What if he was telling me the truth?
scripts.translation: 爷爷说不能跟陌生人走，不然他们会拔光我们的刺。万一他说的是真的呢？

scripts.text: Don't worry. Your thorns are so sharp, no one would dare touch them.
scripts.translation: 别怕，你的刺这么尖，没人敢碰。

scripts.text: Do I still have the flower on my head?
*Sniffle* Yes, it's as pretty as the last time I checked.
scripts.translation: *抽泣* 在呢，和我上次看时一样漂亮。

scripts.text: Then we're all right. Let's just keep moving, and we'll meet Grandma soon.
scripts.translation: 那就好。我们继续往前走，很快就能见到奶奶了。

scripts.text: I can't lose all my thorns and have a smooth face. I'll be so ashamed that I'd want to bury myself in the ground.
scripts.translation: 要是刺都掉光，脸变得光溜溜的，我会羞愧得想把自己埋进土里。

scripts.text: This place is amazing. Look at these big wooden houses.
scripts.translation: 这里真棒。看那些大木屋！海

scripts.text: There are trees growing on the sea, and they all look alike.
scripts.translation: 上还长着树，而且每棵都长得一样。

scripts.text: *Whine* Nahari, Grandma is not going to be happy with us.
scripts.translation: *呜咽* 纳哈里，奶奶会担心我们的。趁

scripts.text: Let's go back before she gets worried.
scripts.translation: 她还没着急，我们赶快回去吧。

scripts.text: But we don't even know where we are.
scripts.translation: 可是我们都不知道自己

scripts.text: Let's look around for a little longer. Look, there are a lot of strangers over there!
scripts.translation: 在哪儿。再逛一会儿吧。看，那边有好多陌生人！

scripts.text: What if we can't go back home?
scripts.translation: 要是我们回不了家怎么办？

scripts.text: Maybe we should explore beyond the mine, and go deep as far as we can.
scripts.translation: 不如去矿场那边探探路，能走多深就走多深。

scripts.text: What if it's too dangerous? I said we should take a detour and go someplace else.
scripts.translation: 要是里面太危险怎么办？我说过应该绕路去别的地方。

scripts.text: Or we could become the pathfinders of an unknown world!
scripts.translation: 要不我们当未知世界的探路先锋！

scripts.text: No. The east side is overrun with the Buffalo Bandits. We should wait until the situation with them is resolved.
scripts.translation: 不行，东边到处都是野牛强盗。等那边的问题解决了再说。

scripts.text: I've decided! I'm going to join the Vigilantes!
scripts.translation: 我决定了！我要加入义警队！

scripts.text: Are you sure they'll let you in?
I don't know, but I'm tired of twiddling my thumbs. This can't be the end of our journey!
scripts.translation: 不知道，但我受够了闲着没事干。我们的旅程可不能就这么结束！

scripts.text: We haven't worked for days. Can you believe that?
scripts.translation: 我们已经好几天没干活了，你敢信？

scripts.text: We can't work, and yet we're not allowed to leave. How unfair is that?
scripts.translation: 不让我们干活，还不准我们离开，这也太不公平了吧？

scripts.text: If this doesn't get solved by tomorrow, then I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 明天之前要是还解决不了，我就走人！

scripts.text: It seems we wouldn't be working today, just like yesterday and the day before.
scripts.translation: 看来今天又没活干，和昨天、前天一样。

scripts.text: I'd hate to go back home empty-handed again.
Maybe I should deal with the Buffalo Bandits myself.
scripts.translation: 也许我该自己去收拾那些野牛强盗。

scripts.text: When can we start working again?
scripts.translation: 我们什么时候才能复工？

scripts.text: How long do we have to wait around?
You calm down. We're losing money every hour just by sitting around.
scripts.translation: 你倒是冷静！我们每多坐一小时，就多亏一小时的钱。

scripts.text: We can't do anything until we get our supplies.
scripts.translation: 物资没到之前，我们什么也做不了。
那到底什么时候才能到？

scripts.text: There's nothing we could do. The Buffalo Bandits stole our last shipment, and it won't be the last time they do it.
scripts.translation: 我们也没办法。野牛强盗抢走了最后一批货，而且他们肯定还会再来。

scripts.text: I don't care. If I can't work tomorrow, then I'll walk out of here!
scripts.translation: 我不管！明天还不能开工，我就走人！

scripts.text: Does the sheriff even care about this situation?
Maybe I should join the Vigilantes.
Forget it. I tried, and got flat out rejected.
scripts.translation: 算了，我试过了，人家直接拒绝了。

scripts.text: Sigh... How long do we have to wait?
Did you know most buildings on the first level of Rock Ridge have a gigantic signboard in front of them?
scripts.translation: 你知道洛克理奇一层的大多数建筑前面都有块巨大的招牌吗？

scripts.text: It's an interesting phenomenon. I think the signboards are supposed to make the buildings look like they have two stories, at least on the front.
scripts.translation: 这现象挺有意思的。我觉得招牌是为了让建筑从正面看起来像有两层。

scripts.text: Actually, they used to be two stories before the basement was created. The owners must miss having two stories.
scripts.translation: 地下室建起来之前，它们确实是两层楼。店主们肯定很怀念原来的样子。

scripts.text: Hey, why can't you give me a loan?
scripts.translation: 喂，你们为什么不肯借钱给我？

scripts.text: We're sorry, but we do not offer services to individual customers.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我们不向个人客户提供这项服务。

scripts.text: Are you kidding me? I used your services yesterday. Look, don't you remember me?
scripts.translation: 你开玩笑吧？我昨天还用过你们的服务。你看，不记得我了吗？

scripts.text: Let me see your ID. As you know, a lot of people here look alike.
scripts.translation: 请出示身份证件。您也知道，这里有很多人长得很像。

scripts.text: I'm responsible for all transaction errors caused by misidentification. Please, you have to understand me.
scripts.translation: 如果因为认错人导致交易出错，我得负责。请您体谅。

scripts.text: Thank you for your understanding. Have a good day.
scripts.translation: 感谢您的理解，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text: Welcome to GC Bank's Rock Ridge branch. How may I assist you today?
scripts.translation: 欢迎光临 GC 银行洛克理奇分行。今天有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: You don't have an account with us, but you do have an account under the name of {0}. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
scripts.translation: 您在我们银行没有账户，不过您名下有一个以{0}为名的账户。今天还需要别的帮助吗？

scripts.text: but our investment products are only for businesses.
scripts.translation: 我们的投资产品只面向企业客户。

scripts.text: Not many people know about it because it doesn't have many branches yet.
scripts.translation: 行吗？我们分行还不多，所以知道的人不多。

scripts.text: And its main customers are companies and other businesses.
scripts.translation: 而且我们的主要客户是公司和其他企业。

scripts.text: Of course, we serve individual customers as well, but companies are what keep most banks in business.
scripts.translation: 当然，我们也服务个人客户，不过大多数银行还是靠企业客户维持经营。

scripts.text: This is just a rumor, but the founder of GC Bank named his bank after what he loved the most: gold coins.
scripts.translation: 这只是个传闻：GC 银行创办人用自己最喜欢的东西给银行命名——金币。

scripts.text: Can't you see the big beautiful gold coin on the roof of this building?
scripts.translation: 您没看到这栋楼顶上那枚又大又漂亮的金币吗？

scripts.text: We're in a desert and I can't go into the building, but I hope you'll enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation: 白了。这里毕竟是沙漠，我也进不了大楼。祝您在这里过得愉快。

scripts.text: Are you looking for a good weapon? You know guns are the main weapons of this area, right?
scripts.translation: 想找把好枪吗？这里主要用枪械作战，你知道吧？

scripts.text: Ah, the shop is closed. Sanders, the owner, went out to the desert, swinging a gun, to hunt the Buffalo Bandits himself. Then he fell and hurt his back.
scripts.translation: 唉，商店关门了。店主桑德斯亲自带枪去了沙漠，想猎杀野牛强盗，结果摔伤了腰。

scripts.text: Don't worry. You can still buy a gun. Sanders Jr. has rented a corner of the tool shop, so he could sell a few guns there.
scripts.translation: 别担心，还是买得到枪的。小桑德斯在工具店租了个角落，摆了几把枪卖。

scripts.text: He doesn't carry as wide a selection of products as his father, but he has an assortment of well-chosen models.
scripts.translation: 他卖的种类不如父亲齐全，不过挑的都是些不错的型号。

scripts.text: Akuha! Nahari! Where have they gone?
scripts.translation: 阿库哈！纳哈里！你们去哪儿了？

scripts.text: Have you seen a couple of Cactus children, a boy and a girl?
scripts.translation: 你们见过一男一女两个仙人掌孩子吗？

scripts.text: I've brought them here to show them around the strangers' village, and I lost them in a crowd.
scripts.translation: 我带他们来外来者的村子逛逛，结果一转眼就在人群里走散了。

scripts.text: What should I do? Akuha! Nahari!
If you see them, please tell them their grandma is looking for them.
scripts.translation: 里！如果见到他们，告诉他们奶奶正在找他们。

scripts.text: Did you hear that? The basement is haunted!
scripts.translation: 你听说了吗？地下室闹鬼了！

scripts.text: Word is that some worker couldn't get out in time before the basement was buried.
scripts.translation: 听说地下室被填埋前，有个工人没能及时逃出

scripts.text: This place has so many people coming in and out of it, it's hard to keep track of every one of them.
scripts.translation: 来。这里人来人往，谁也顾不上数清到底有多少人。

scripts.text: Some workers went down to the basement for repair work and heard strange rustling noises.
scripts.translation: 有些工人下到地下室维修时，听见了奇怪的窸窣声。等他们

scripts.text: When they found the source of noise? kyaaaahhh!
scripts.translation: 找到声音来源时...呀啊啊！

scripts.text: Lucas! Do you want me to kill you? Stop doing that!
scripts.translation: 卢卡斯！你想害我吓死吗？别这样！

scripts.text: Aww, I'm too scared to talk about this anymore.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我不敢再说这件事了。

scripts.text: The basement is haunted. You don't really believe that, do you?
scripts.translation: 地下室闹鬼？你不会真信了吧？我

scripts.text: I think there are treasures down there.
And whoever spread that stupid rumor, he did it to keep others from finding out about the treasures.
scripts.translation: 散布那个蠢谣言的人，肯定是想阻止别人发现宝藏。

scripts.text: Hm, I meant that as a joke, but maybe she really is scared.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我本来是开玩笑的，不过她好像真的害

scripts.text: What do you say, Carola? How'd you like to go down there with me?
scripts.translation: 怕了。卡萝拉，你觉得呢？要不要跟我下去

scripts.text: Ah, adventurer. Let's keep this just between you and me, okay?
scripts.translation: 看看？冒险者，这事可得替我保密，好吗？

scripts.text: What am I looking at? Ah, those buffaloes. There's a large sum of money offered for their heads.
scripts.translation: 我在看什么？哦，那些野牛。有人悬赏重金要他们的脑袋。

scripts.text: The Vigilantes and the Sheriff have had enough with them, now that they started robbing the train.
scripts.translation: 他们开始抢火车后，义警和警长都受够了。

scripts.text: But thanks to them, I've got a lucrative job.
scripts.translation: 不过多亏了他们，我才接到这份赚钱的活。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, guys. I should've never taken you here...
scripts.translation: 对不起，伙计们，我不该带你们来这里...

scripts.text: I didn't know there was no grass here.
scripts.translation: 我不知道这里连草都没有。

scripts.text: Just hang in there. I'm growing some grass for you out there. If it grows well, you wouldn't have to be hungry anymore.
scripts.translation: 再撑一撑。我正在外面给你们种草。长好了，你们就不用挨饿了。

scripts.text: The houses closer to the beach have always been prone to sinking, long before the first level was buried.
scripts.translation: 靠海滩的房子一直容易下沉，早在原来的一层被填埋之前就这样了。

scripts.text: This house sank little by little, until the ground couldn't hold its weight anymore.
scripts.translation: 这栋房子一点点往下陷，直到地面再也撑不住它的重量。

scripts.text: What happened to its residents, you ask? You're an adventurer, why do you care?
scripts.translation: 你问原来的住户去哪儿了？你一个冒险者，干嘛关心这个？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to get angry with you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不是有意冲你发火。

scripts.text: It's just that... things haven't been good.
But at least I have work to do and food to eat, thanks to some people.
scripts.translation: 不过多亏了好心人，我至少还有工作做、有饭吃

scripts.text: Where do I get work and food? Head up to the eastern gate. You'll see the along the way.
scripts.translation: 。想找工作和吃饭的地方？往东门那边走，路上就能看到。

scripts.text: Are you going to go in?
You'd better get out of there
*Sniff Sniff* Doesn't this place smell good to you? I love its salty, dank, musty smell! I could live here for the rest of my life!
scripts.translation: *嗅嗅* 你不觉得这里闻起来很棒吗？我最喜欢这种咸咸的、潮湿阴暗又发霉的味道！我愿意在这里住一辈子！

scripts.text: ...If only there weren't so many bugs. I'm just going to bottle the smell and take it with me.
scripts.translation: ...要是虫子没那么多就好了。我干脆把这味道装瓶带走吧。

scripts.text: See those sea anemones? They keep clogging up the sewer pipes, so we get rid of them on a regular basis. I like sitting here and watching them move. And when I do, time goes by so quickly.
scripts.translation: 看到那些海葵了吗？它们老是堵住下水道，我们得定期清理。我喜欢坐在这儿看它们挪动。看着看着，时间就过得飞快。

scripts.text: At least during that time I could forget my reality, about the mine, not having jobs, you know, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation: 至少那会儿我能暂时忘掉现实，忘掉矿场、失业，还有那些乱七八糟的烦心事。

scripts.text: I'm here because I have nowhere else to go, but I'll go back up once those who took up residence in the mine are gone.
scripts.translation: 我无处可去，才躲在这里。等占着矿场的那些家伙离开后，我就回地面去。

scripts.text: This place hasn't changed at all.
Remember when we first came here?
scripts.translation: 还记得我们刚来这里的时候吗？

scripts.text: We built this house from scratch, on our own from the foundation stones to the roofing.
scripts.translation: 这房子是我们亲手从无到有盖起来的，从打地基到铺屋顶全都自己做。

scripts.text: Aww, it's getting chilly. Let's go back up.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，有点冷了。我们回地面吧。

scripts.text: My lovely Clementine... I proposed to her here.
scripts.translation: 我亲爱的克莱门汀...我就是在这里向她求婚的。

scripts.text: My Clementine is not so old!
scripts.translation: 我的克莱门汀才不老呢！

scripts.text: Mm? Who's there? Is it you, Charlie?
scripts.translation: 嗯？谁在那里？是你吗，查理？

scripts.text: Charlie can't come here. He lives across the sea.
scripts.translation: 查理来不了，他住在海的另一边。

scripts.text: Does he? By the way, this place has changed a lot.
scripts.translation: 是吗？对了，这里变化真大。

scripts.text: No, it hasn't. It's just the same as when we left it.
scripts.translation: 哪有，和我们离开时一模一样。

scripts.text: Is it? I come here when I miss the old days, but it's too dark. By the way, why has it become so wet?
scripts.translation: 是吗？我怀念过去时就会来这里，可这里太暗了。对了，怎么变得这么潮湿？

scripts.text: It was flooded. That's why it had to be filled up and we had to move up. Have you gone senile? You were the one who insisted this place was too low to build houses on.
scripts.translation: 这里发过洪水，所以才得填起来，我们也才搬到上面去。你糊涂了吗？当初坚持说这里地势太低、不适合盖房子的，不就是你吗？

scripts.text: Mommy, when can we live above ground again?
scripts.translation: 妈妈，我们什么时候能回到地面上住？

scripts.text: Soon. When Daddy can go work at the mine again. When Mommy and Daddy make enough money to buy back the house.
scripts.translation: 快了。等爸爸能回矿场工作，等我们攒够钱把房子买回来。

scripts.text: I haven't been able to feed my child well. I can't remember the last time he had a decent meal.
scripts.translation: 我没能让孩子吃饱。我都不记得他上次好好吃一顿是什么时候了。

scripts.text: Let's wait for Daddy. He'll be back with food.
scripts.translation: 我们等爸爸回来吧，他会带吃的。

scripts.text: What, haven't you seen a Buffalo Bandit before?
scripts.translation: 怎么，没见过野牛强盗吗？

scripts.text: Don't give me that dirty look. We're not doing anything bad right now, now are we?
scripts.translation: 别用那种眼神看我。我们现在又没干什么坏事，对吧？

scripts.text: You're on our turf. Don't cause trouble, and stay away from here.
scripts.translation: 这是我们的地盘。别惹麻烦，离远点。

scripts.text: I'll let you come and go, if you promise me not to tell anyone above the ground about us. Promise?
scripts.translation: 你要是答应不把我们的事告诉地面上的人，我就让你进出。说好了？

scripts.text: Aside from the main gate, there are are a few more entrances that only we know, and we guard one of them.
scripts.translation: 除了正门，还有几个入口只有我们知道，其中一个由我们把守。

scripts.text: Why are you telling me this?
So you'd be scared and want to stay away.
scripts.translation: 这样你就会害怕，不敢靠近了。

scripts.text: Can you believe some people actually live here? People above ground don't care about them. Officially, this place is vacant, even though it's not.
scripts.translation: 你能相信这里真的有人住吗？地面上的人根本不在乎他们。官方说这里没人住，明明并非如此。

scripts.text: They don't want to know or care. You have to be in a pretty bad situation to end up here.
scripts.translation: 他们既不想了解，也不关心。只有日子过得特别艰难的人，才会沦落到这里。

scripts.text: Erekter wants to become the best netter in the village when he grows up.
scripts.translation: 埃雷克特长大后想成为村里最棒的织网师。

scripts.text: The best netter in the village is Mrs. Soft Feather.
scripts.translation: 村里最棒的织网师是软羽女士。

scripts.text: Mm... Then I'll become the second-best netter in the village!
scripts.translation: 嗯...那我就当村里第二棒的织网师！

scripts.text: Ho ho ho, there's not a single fishing net in the village that hasn't been handled by me.
scripts.translation: 呵呵呵，村里每一张渔网都经我手。也

scripts.text: There are others who make good nets, but I'm the one who gives the nets their finishing touch.
scripts.translation: 有人织得不错，但最后的修整总得由我来做。

scripts.text: I want to learn from you too! I want to become as good at netting as you!
scripts.translation: 我也想跟您学！我也想像您一样擅长织网！

scripts.text: Your hands are too soft right now. Go out and play. I'll teach you when your hands become tougher.
scripts.translation: 你的小手还太嫩，先出去玩吧。等手变结实了，我再教你。

scripts.text: Yes, I'll teach you how to net. For now, let me teach you how to make pretty knots with grass blades.
scripts.translation: 好啊，我会教你织网。不过眼下先教你用草叶打漂亮的结。
